support_page.title: Support access
support_page.intro: Open {{company}} to the platform’s support when you ask it for help: it then sees your screens as you do, without being able to change anything.
support_page.reads: It reads everything the company holds, read-only.
support_page.never: It exports nothing, prints no selection of documents and does not see cost prices.
support_page.logged: Its arrival and every page it reads are written in the
support_page.owner_only: Only the company’s owner opens support access.
support_page.open_until: Support may read the company until {{until}}.
support_page.reason_hint: What support should look at, for instance “the 3 March invoice prints without the stamp”. They read it on opening the company.

refused.network: The request did not go through. Try again.
refused.not_found: This company can no longer be reached.
refused.owner_only: Only the owner opens support access.
refused.support_window: Choose one of the lengths offered.
refused.support_reason: What is wrong is too long for support: shorten it.
refused.step_up_required: Nothing changed: confirm it is you to make this change.
